_comment: RUSH E hard (2026-10-28, the user's per-section pick from three variants: "RushE Hard: 1O 2- 3- 4- 5O 6O 7F 8- 9O 10C 11C 12-"). The base is the user's hand-edited Hard snapped to the audio (every position, colour, arrow and long note kept); notes of the E chart (the full Beat Saber map RUSH E (v2) by JonathanRune, BeatSaver 1eb9) were added only in the chosen sections, each section taking the additions of the variant the user picked (O = Opus: onset strength x beat weight, F = Fable: melody contour, C = Codex), within the body limits (same hand 0.25 s, instants 0.12 s, 14 instants per 2 s). Assembled from the variants of dev/tools/ChartRushE/faithful.py and two design subagents.
